distinction.rule: Pax Domini, the celebrant's peace prayer, and the ministerial Pax transmission are distinct canonical events and may not be collapsed.

primaryAuthority.section: Ritus servandus in celebratione Missae X.8
normalizedEvidence: The deacon awaits the Pax at the celebrant's right.
The celebrant gives the Pax to the deacon with Pax tecum.
The deacon then gives the Pax to the subdeacon.
The subdeacon carries the Pax to the choir and then to the accompanying acolyte.

corroboratingAuthority.work: J. B. O'Connell, The Celebration of Mass (1962)
corroboratingAuthority.section: General Ceremonies of Solemn Mass — The Kiss of Peace
normalizedEvidence: At ordinary Solemn Mass the Pax is transmitted through the sacred ministers.
The subdeacon distributes the Pax to those in choir.

negativeAuthority.rule: In Masses for the dead the Domine Iesu Christe qui dixisti prayer and the Pax are omitted.
